title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Xtreme Sour Apple Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Xtreme Sour Apple Nic Salt delivers a bold Green Apple flavour with a sour-sweet twist. The Apple note is tart and juicy, enhanced by a zingy sour edge reminiscent of classic confectionery flavours. A sharp, satisfying vape for fans of tangy fruit blends. Formulated at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine delivery. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
